Spain Wins 2026 FIFA World Cup in Extra-Time Thriller

Spain has been crowned champions of the 2026 FIFA World Cup, defeating Argentina in a closely contested final that went into extra time. The match featured a dramatic halftime show and concluded with Spain setting a new defensive record. The tournament also saw significant individual awards and notable moments for star players.
